name: v1.2.0 - Xbox support
body:
## New: Xbox support

- Add `xbox` field to user profile config
- Support **official Xbox integration** (`binary_sensor.{gamertag}`) with auto-discovery of `sensor.{gamertag}_now_playing`, `sensor.{gamertag}_status`, `image.{gamertag}_gamerpic`, `image.{gamertag}_now_playing`
- Support **gaming_status Xbox sensor** (`sensor.gaming_status_{username}_xbox`)
- Game priority: Discord > Xbox > Steam
- Xbox platform badge (mdi:microsoft-xbox) with green color
- Updated README with Xbox documentation and examples

### Example

```yaml
users:
  - name: "Player 1"
    xbox: binary_sensor.xbox_player_1
  - name: "Player 2"
    xbox: sensor.gaming_status_player_1_xbox
    discord: sensor.discord_user_123456789
```
